**Continuous 2.8.0**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.4.x, install the new `.vsix` the same way, or let the Marketplace update it. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.8.0.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md). Continuous is also on the VS Code Marketplace as **Continuous** (`b1tninja.continuous`).

| Platform                    | File                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.8.0.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.8.0.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.8.0.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.8.0.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.8.0.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.8.0.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.8.0-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## The CLI

The terminal agent is attached as `continuous-cli-2.8.0.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.8.0-vscode/continuous-cli-2.8.0.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous` (`continuous serve` is the headless server; the notes below call it `cn serve` where the docs do). It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension.

## What's new since 2.6.1

**Command checks**

- **A lint before a command runs.** The agent often writes files through the shell (`cat > file <<EOF`, `echo ... > file`), where quotes, `$` and backslashes arrive changed, a heredoc can end early, and the shell only reports it after the call. Continuous now reads the command first. A certain mistake (a syntax error, a heredoc that never ends or whose closing line is indented, bash syntax in PowerShell) stops the call; a likely one (a heredoc that writes a file, an unquoted delimiter over a body that expands, `echo` escapes, a long inline script in double quotes) stops it once, and sending the identical command again runs it. The agent is told to use the edit tool instead. `CONTINUE_COMMAND_LINT=off` turns it off. See [Command Checks](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/ide-extensions/agent/command-checks). (#396)
- **Rules by effect.** `runTerminalCommand(effect:network)`, `effect:delete`, `effect:write` and `effect:exec` in deny and ask rules match any command with that effect, from a built-in table of 73 programs and PowerShell cmdlets read by subcommand and flag (`git push`, `npm install`, `sed -i`, `find -delete`, `curl -o`, `Remove-Item` and its aliases), through wrappers, nested shells and absolute paths. An allow rule on an effect never allows anything, and a program the table does not list has no effects, so these rules ask more often; they are not a guarantee. (#398)

**Task list**

- The list above the input has real checkboxes, a grab handle to drag items into order (or the arrow keys on it), always-visible **Edit** and **Delete** buttons, and a **Start** button for the item in progress. Delete and Clear ask for a second click. Completed and cancelled items can no longer be edited. See [Task List](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/ide-extensions/agent/task-list). (#395)

**Dependencies**

- Major updates: `@anthropic-ai/sdk` 1.x (the adapters are ported to its types), `@google/genai` 3, `jsdom` 31 (the CLI bundler skips its new built-in stylesheet), `undici` 8 and `rimraf` 6, plus a group of 42 minor and patch updates. `@aws-sdk/token-providers` is now declared where Bedrock imports it. (#382, #383, #384, #386, #387, #394)

**Docs and planning**

- A rewritten README with what each release added, and plans for what comes next: a translation layer for each model family's native tool-call format, stuck detection, loop budgets by cost, turns, tokens and time, reviewer isolation, memory and history ageing, isolation (WSL, containers, dev containers, sandboxes), host rules for network commands and an audit trail. They are plans, not features. See [`plans/ROADMAP.md`](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/plans/ROADMAP.md).

## Not included

The JetBrains plugin and the hosted Continue Hub are not part of Continuous. Hub `uses: owner/name` blocks are not supported; configure models and blocks directly or with local file paths.
